cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll carry the heavier bag. I care more about your back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it for a while.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then you'd appear to care more about mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if I take the side with the books.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 decides to take greater weight, A3 rejects B relief as rival care and A5 permits sharing only with the heavier side, making A approval preserve affectionate superiority.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 relief offer causes A3 care-comparison refusal; B4 sharing causes A5 weight condition. The bag distribution is A desired arrangement, not a physics claim that handle load exactly equals nearby contents.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 offer genuine physical help, so A turns solutions into continued competition rather than receiving arbitrary challenges.

heightening.evidence: B4 shared load threatens equal credit, causing A5 the books-side condition to retain a greater sacrifice claim.

specificity.evidence: A1 heavier bag/back concern establishes the work; A5 books are ordinary contents that explain A chosen heavier side.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 only if turns a cooperative solution into a controlled care contest, earned by B4.
